novel_features.name: Country lookup
novel_features.description: Fuzzy-search Comtrade country reporters by name, ISO2, ISO3, or numeric code.
novel_features.rationale: Local cache of the public Reporters reference avoids 60K-row downloads on every lookup.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When an agent needs Egypt's numeric Comtrade code without making the user know the magic number 818.

novel_features.name: HS code search
novel_features.description: Fuzzy-search HS6 commodity codes by code prefix or text description.
novel_features.rationale: Local cache of the H6 reference (~50K rows) makes HS lookups instant after the first run.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When an agent needs the HS code for a commodity name.

novel_features.name: Annual import volumes
novel_features.description: Annual import volume for a country/HS pair from a specific partner (default China).
novel_features.rationale: Resolves country and partner names to numeric codes locally, queries Comtrade preview, aggregates per-year primaryValue and netWgt.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When an agent needs concrete trade-flow numbers for a prospect.

novel_features.name: Composite prospect-fit score
novel_features.description: 0-100 score combining China-share of imports, year-over-year growth, and route coverage.
novel_features.rationale: Three Comtrade calls + a hardcoded covered-lane portfolio produce a single number suitable for ranking prospects.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When an agent needs to rank candidate destinations for an outbound campaign.

narrative.headline: A single-binary CLI for UN Comtrade trade-flow data — converts country names and HS descriptions into numeric codes locally, then pulls per-year import volumes for ocean-freight prospect research.
narrative.value_prop: Comtrade's official portal requires a paid key for the production API, but the public preview endpoint exposes the same trade-flow shape with a 500-record cap. webprofile-pp-cli wraps it for ocean-freight forwarders: country and HS lookups happen offline (cached reference files), and prospect-fit scoring combines import volume, growth, and your route portfolio into a single number.

quickstart.comment: Resolve a country name to its Comtrade numeric code (cached after first run).
Find the HS code for a commodity description.
Pull 3 years of Egypt's telephone imports from China.
Score this country/HS as a prospect (0-100).

troubleshoots.symptom: Empty result for a country/HS pair
troubleshoots.fix: Comtrade preview is rate-limited and capped at 500 records; reduce --years or check the country/HS via  and .
The first call fetches and caches the Reporters/HS reference files (~1.6 MB combined); subsequent calls are instant.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when an agent needs trade-flow data for ocean-freight prospect research. The transcendence commands (country, hs-search, who-imports, fit-score) read from the local cache, so they answer prospecting questions a generic Comtrade scraper cannot.
